text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next stop is the final stop... the final stop...
Please make sure you have all your belongings with you.’"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way, I totally missed my stop!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if I get off at the next stop and switch to the opposite line,
there's no way I'll make curfew in time."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mane-G... is still in a meeting
at the agency, right...? *sigh*
Gold City ended up returning past curfew and was reprimanded...
